notes.title: PATCH: 1.2.0.8
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27285702/580a766987ec06d61ed26c73c2f9e0c753b9fa0e.png

1.2.0.8
    Features:

Our Magic Enemies now have completed forms. This includes a Large, Mini Boss and Main Boss
New Armor Set. 
New Magic Weapons, Has increased Crit base compared to others

    Bug Fixes:

Fixed issue with survival mode not progressing. 
Fixed issue with Main Boss not spawning at right floor number.
Fixed issue with Skeleton Main Boss was not getting hit sounds.
Fixed issue with Coin UI text if over 1000 coins.


Please keep that feedback coming, we are developing a road map of requested features and items we have seen that is needed in the game. 

Thanks everyone for playing and the support!

notes.title: Patch on Friday!
notes.notes:
On Friday we will be releasing 1.2!
This will include the magic species' weapons as well as completing the magic species' load out with a new Large mob, Mini Boss, and Main Boss. As Well as a new armor set. 

We will also be addressing some bugs and balancing that players have been experiencing. 

Thank you for your patience everyone!

notes.title: PATCH: 1.0.1a
notes.notes:
1.0.1a
    Content:

Trading Cards/ Backgrounds/ Emoticons now enabled.  
Steam LeaderBoards enabled. ( Leaderboard Page)

    Bug Fixes:

Fixed some null references that sometimes occurred when attacking the large hairy and the skeleton boss with default arrow,long arrow, and bolts
Fixed an issue involving the skeleton boss, arrows/bolts, and possibly being able to obtain the friends hate you achievement when you shouldn't.
Fixed the issue with backing out from the floors menu and going back to the floors menu sometimes resulted in no number being shown for the current selection.
Fixed the issue with backing out from the floors menu showing the arrow next to crawl yet skipping floors and going straight to VS when the player presses the down button/axis.
Fixed the issue with the up arrow being displayed on the floors menu when the player has 100 floors selected.
Fixed a typo on the credits screen.
Fixed an issue with checking whether or not the player has enough money to buy potions in survival.
Fixed the issue that resulted in the leftHairySpiderEdges and rightHairySpiderEdges being null causing them to sometimes get stuck when the player selected snow or castle rooms after the boss level.
Fixed issue with player spawning dead after hitting retry on gameover screen.
Fixed some background audio not reflecting volume changes.
Fixed enemy hits not reflecting volume changes.
Fixed Issue with boss not hitting on his sides 
Fixed Incorrect label of bows.
Fixed Hairy Mini boss's death animation.
